description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) that extends a base FilterParams class to encapsulate search filter parameters for claim expense searches within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used to specify search filter parameters for claim expense queries, primarily holding request ID and allowed sort fields.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the filter parameters.
